notes.subject: ol ban bilong du
notes.rationale: מנעליך: 'ol ban bilong du' (ASV/JPS/BSB, bolting Asher's fortified towns) o 'su bilong yu' (KJV, from מנעל 'shoe'); lemma data i tok 'bolt'.

notes.subject: דבאך
notes.rationale: dov'ah — tok i stap long Tanakh long hia tasol; mining i 'kaikai / strong', ol man i tanim 'strength'.

notes.subject: וכימיך דבאך
notes.rationale: Hibru: 'na olsem ol de bilong yu — strong bilong yu'; Tok Pisin i laikim 'olsem tu' bilong stretim pasin.

translation: Bara na kaper ol ban bilong du bilong yu; na olsem ol de bilong yu, olsem tu strong bilong yu.
